# ChatCart Pro

> ChatCart Pro is an AI ordering system for supermarkets, mini marts and restaurants in the UAE (and India). It runs on the business's own WhatsApp number and phone line. Customers order by chatting or calling in Tamil, Hindi, Malayalam, Telugu or English. The AI takes the order, checks live stock from the store's system (for example GOFRUGAL), and sends it to a kitchen display or store dashboard, with delivery rider management built in. Built by Nexsofture Tech FZ LLC, Dubai.

Key facts:
- It is an ordering system, not a WhatsApp marketing tool.
- Customers never leave WhatsApp: no app, no web menu link.
- Voice ordering is for inbound customer calls only.
- Customers are told they are talking to an AI assistant; calls are recorded with notice.
- Zero commission on orders. Flat monthly price per store, one-time setup fee, WhatsApp (Meta) message fees billed at cost.
- Uses the official WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API) from Meta.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://chatcartpro.com/): What ChatCart Pro does, how it works, features, FAQ and demo booking.
- [Supermarkets & mini marts](https://chatcartpro.com/whatsapp-ai-for-grocery-stores/): Grocery lists by WhatsApp or phone, live stock check, substitutions, delivery.
- [Restaurants & cafeterias](https://chatcartpro.com/whatsapp-ai-for-restaurants/): Takeaway and delivery orders to the kitchen display, no delivery-app commission.
- [Multi-branch chains](https://chatcartpro.com/whatsapp-ordering-for-grocery-chains/): One dashboard and per-branch stock for several stores.
- [Pricing](https://chatcartpro.com/pricing/): Single-store and multi-branch plans, shown in the visitor's local currency (AED, INR or USD).
